why: Pre-command callback that blocks dangerous shell commands (rm -rf /, curl|sh to unknown hosts, reading ~/.ssh or env dumps) by raising CommandBlockedError before they reach the guest. Every attempt, allowed or blocked, is appended to logs/commands.jsonl for full auditability.

InternetSettings(mode='off') disables all outbound network access during detonation, preventing exfiltration of data or download of additional payloads. Evidence shows curl fails inside the guest when network is off.

Checkpoint 'before-detonation' taken before the risky import/execute step so a failure or compromise can roll back to a known-good state. Used for the step-7 rollback failure policy to restore and retry without recreating the full sandbox.
